description: I’m worried about Governor Pritzker’s cognitive decline. He’s claiming President Trump nowhas dementia. When the redistricting issue came up in Texas, the Texas delegates came toIllinois for sanctuary. Governor Pritzker calls a presser and some of the first words out of hismouth is that everybody knows Donald Trump likes to cheat. I’m not sure if he is practicingselective memory or if he has convenient amnesia, but he was caught trying to cheat the taxpayers out of $280,000.00 in property taxes
title: Governor Pritzker’s Cognitive Decline or Just Selective Memory?
